Tamil Nadu CM Defends Law and Order, Accuses Opposition of Interference

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin defended his government's law and order record, accusing the opposition DMK of interfering with police operations. Governor R.N. Ravi praised Stalin's performance and highlighted his exposure of DMK corruption in the Assembly. Ravi also noted his decade-long demand for live telecasts of Assembly proceedings, which he stated were facilitated by the TVK. The Chief Minister's defense came amid ongoing political exchanges regarding governance and police conduct.
